request_description: The architecture consists of a web application 'Alien' running on a Tomcat web server, which is hosted on a virtual machine 'vm_app'. The web application connects to an Elasticsearch software component hosted on another virtual machine 'vm_search'. Both virtual machines are connected to the same internal network 'internal_net' and run Linux with JDK 17.0.0. The architecture ensures that the web application can interact with Elasticsearch for search functionalities.
